notes: Control points: CT 1980 'West of Middle-earth' pixel [x, y] (3840x2931, y down) vs ME-GIS km [x east, y north]. megisKm from data/world/places.json 'canonical' where the id exists there, else derived from data/source/arda/vectors/vectors.gpkg (or the 10k ME-DEM for tolfalas) as described in each note. confidence: 3 = symbol/sharp feature placed within ~3 px, 2 = feature clear but its definition differs slightly between maps, 1 = label-only or loosely defined. "fit": false = reported but not used in the fits (grey-havens shares its CT pixel with gulf-of-lune-head).
